d: Long, flowing platinum white hair cascades from beneath a dark navy headband featuring a red flame pattern, framing a youthful face with sharp, narrow amber eyes. The athletic build is marked by red tribal tattoos across the chest and right shoulder, paired with a muscular torso. The outfit consists of a dark navy and charcoal grey open-chested ensemble with baggy trousers, complemented by a gold ornate belt, white fabric wraps around the waist, and white open-toed sandals. Signature details include a long red scarf fluttering behind and a small silver earring in the left ear.
